content: OpenAI Structured Outputs (json_schema) require all fields to be listed in 'required'; use nullable union types (str | None) rather than Optional to allow null. The 'nullable' keyword is often silently ignored. additionalProperties must be false (closed schema). Total schema field count should stay under ~30 fields; deeply nested schemas increase latency and refusal risk. OpenAI Python SDK v1.40+ supports .parse() with Pydantic; structured outputs work with streaming. Response is guaranteed syntactically valid but field content can still deviate from schema semantics.
